text.help-text: Stacked = image on top, 2 across (3 on a full-width page). Compact = tinted panel with a small optional thumbnail, best for link lists and quick facts.
text.label: Card Style

text.help-text: Short label above the title, e.g. Associate Degree. Optional.
text.label: Eyebrow

text.help-text: The only required field on a card.
text.label: Title

text.help-text: One or two sentences. Keep it short — cards in a row size to the tallest one.
text.label: Body

asset.help-text: Optional. Stacked cards crop to 16:9 (640 x 360 px is plenty); compact cards crop to a 76 px square. Either give every card in the row an image or give none of them one.
asset.label: Image

text.help-text: Describe the image for screen readers. Leave blank if the image is decorative and the title already says what it shows.
text.label: Alternative Text

asset.help-text: Optional. Links the whole card. Choose a page, file, or link on this site.
asset.label: Link

text.help-text: For off-site destinations only, e.g. https://catalog.mchenry.edu/... Ignored if a Link is chosen above.
text.label: External Link URL

text.help-text: Optional call-to-action text, e.g. Program details. Only appears if the card has a link.
text.label: Link Label
